Image Summary: Graph of a piecewise function on a coordinate plane (axes range approximately -10 to 10 on both x and y). The function starts at the bottom-left with negative y-values for x < -6 and increases linearly through negative territory. From -6 to 0, the function curves upward nonlinearly, rising steeply through positive values to a peak near y=8 around x=0. From 0 to approximately x=3, the function remains relatively flat/constant near the peak. From x=3 to x=6, the function decreases. For x > 6, the function continues decreasing, dropping below the x-axis into negative y-values toward the bottom-right.
DR A: Student confused an interval in which the function is increasing linearly with an interval where the function is decreasing, OR student thought that an interval in which all y-values are negative is an interval where the function is decreasing.
DR B: Student confused an interval in which the function is increasing nonlinearly with an interval where the function is decreasing.
DR C: Student confused an interval in which the function is constant with an interval where the function is decreasing.
DR D: Correct.
DR E: Correct.

choice_B: Cameron traveled at a slow pace, stopped, and then traveled at a quick pace.

choice_C: Cameron traveled at a quick pace, stopped, and then traveled at a slow pace.

choice_D: Cameron traveled at a quick pace, slowed down, and then traveled at a quicker pace.
DR D: Student did not recognize that a flat line segment means Cameron did not cover any distance and misinterpreted the slope of the last interval of time.

Question Text: Triangle XYZ is shown in the coordinate grid below. XY and XZ are perpendicular. Triangle XYZ undergoes a transformation to create triangle X'Y'Z'. Which statements are true? Select all that apply.

choice_B: X'Y' and X'Z' will not be perpendicular after a reflection over the y-axis.

choice_D: X'Y' and X'Z' will not be perpendicular after a translation down by 2 units.

choice_E: X'Y' and X'Z' will be perpendicular after a 90° rotation counterclockwise about the origin.

choice_F: X'Y' and X'Z' will not be perpendicular after a 90° rotation counterclockwise about the origin.

choice_A: There is at least one outlier represented in the scatter plot.

choice_B: There is a linear association between distance and time in the scatter plot.
DR B: Correct.
choice_C: There is a nonlinear association between distance and time in the scatter plot.

choice_D: There is a positive association between distance and time in the scatter plot.

Question Text: Which graph has a line that represents the best fit for the recorded data?
Image Summary: Four scatter plots labeled A, B, C, and D, each displaying the same set of data points showing a positive linear trend. Graph A: line of best fit connects only the uppermost data points, positioned too high above the cluster. Graph B: a horizontal line is drawn at the middle y-value, horizontally splitting the data rather than following its trend. Graph C: line of best fit connects only the lowermost data points, positioned too low below the cluster. Graph D: the line runs diagonally through the middle of the data, closely following the upward trend of the points from lower-left to upper-right.
DR A: Student chose a line of best fit that connects the uppermost points, but that does not fit a majority of the data.
DR B: Student chose a line of best fit that "splits" the data horizontally, so that about half of the data points fall above the line and about half of the data points fall below the line.
DR C: Student chose a line of best fit that connects the lowermost points, but that does not fit a majority of the data.
DR D: Correct.
MostCommonDR: Student chose a line of best fit that connects the lowermost points, but that does not fit a majority of the data.
Learning_Component_Text: Informally fit a straight line to model a data set

Question Text: Gokul records historical data for gasoline prices to the nearest five cents in the graph and draws a line of best fit. Which statement is true?
Image Summary: Scatter plot titled "Gasoline Prices Over Time." The x-axis is labeled "Time (in years)" showing years from 1995 to 2004. The y-axis is labeled "Gasoline Price (in dollars/gallon)" ranging from approximately $1.10 to $1.75. Data points trend upward over time from about $1.15 in 1995 to about $1.75 in 2004. A drawn horizontal line sits at approximately $1.40 across the entire graph, which does not follow the upward trend of the data — it is not the correct line of best fit.
choice_A: The line is not the line of best fit because it should pass through (1995, 1.15) and (2004, 1.75).
DR A: Student identified that the line of best fit is not correct, but thought that the line of best fit always goes through the first and last points of the data set.
choice_B: The line is not the line of best fit because there could be a line drawn that would be closer to more points.
DR B: Correct.
choice_C: The line is the line of best fit because it passes through points that are in the middle of the data set.
DR C: Student chose a statement that is not true because the line does not represent a majority of the data points.
choice_D: The line is the line of best fit because half of the points are above the line and half of the points are below the line.
DR D: Student chose a statement that would be true if the line of best fit matched the trajectory of the points.
MostCommonDR: Student chose a statement that is not true because the line does not represent a majority of the data points.
Learning_Component_Text: Informally assess the fit of a straight line used to model a data set by judging the closeness of the data points to the line

Question Text: A group of farmers collected data on the number of foxes and the number of rabbits seen on their properties per week. The scatter plot below shows the data they collected. The farmers used the equation y = -3x + 100 to model the data collected. Based on the equation, which statement is true?
Image Summary: Scatter plot titled "Fox and Rabbit Sightings." The x-axis is labeled "Number of Foxes Seen per Week" ranging from 0 to 9. The y-axis is labeled "Number of Rabbits Seen per Week" ranging from 0 to 110. Data points are scattered across the plot with rabbit sightings ranging from approximately 75 to 105 as fox sightings range from 1 to 8. There is a slight downward trend in the data.
choice_A: Each additional fox is associated with 3 more rabbits.
DR A: Student correctly identified the slope, but interpreted the relative decrease in the number of rabbits as an increase.
choice_B: Each additional fox is associated with 3 fewer rabbits.
DR B: Correct.
choice_C: Each additional fox is associated with 100 more rabbits.
DR C: Student interpreted the y-intercept as the slope and interpreted the relative decrease in the number of rabbits as an increase.
choice_D: Each additional fox is associated with 100 fewer rabbits.
DR D: Student interpreted the y-intercept as the slope, but did correctly identify a decrease in the number of rabbits, not an increase.
MostCommonDR: Student interpreted the y-intercept as the slope and interpreted the relative decrease in the number of rabbits as an increase.
Learning_Component_Text: Interpret the slope of a line of best fit
